sn50.1-12:1.5: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbharā
sn50.1-12:1.6: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcabalāni bhāvento pañcabalāni bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || ||
sn50.1-12:1.7: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcabalāni bhāvento pañcabalāni bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || || 4.
sn50.1-12:1.8: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhābalam bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitam vossagganissitaṃ vossagga parināmiṃ ||
sn50.1-12:1.12: paññābalam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || 4.
sn50.1-12:1.13: Evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcabalāni bhāvento pañcabalāni bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || ||
